title: Hoshino Ichika — Connecting Tones〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...
This seems like a good place to stop.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, guess what? I brought some snacks with me today for all of us! Bon appetit♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you, Saki.
In that case, I think I'll have some.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I've been seeing the commercial for those chocolate ones a lot lately. They're a seasonal flavor, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! There's also...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here! They just came out with these orange-flavored gummies! I really recommend them! When you put one in your mouth, you get hit with a wave of orangey deliciousness!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe. Orangey deliciousness?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You'll know when you try them!
So, here! Have some!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay. I'll take one.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd like some of those chocolate ones.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Take what you like, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh, okay. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi...?
Do you not know which to choose?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, both sound really good...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. Oh, Ichi. You know you can have both, right? I brought plenty.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really? Then, I think I'll do just that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, which do I start with...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I really don't think this requires that much thought.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know. I'm just wondering how the orange gummy will taste after I have something that's chocolate-flavored.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She went through the trouble of bringing them for us, so I'd like to enjoy them in the best way possible.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Ichika, that reminds me of how you couldn't decide which rice ball to eat when I made some for you and Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? That sounds like a fun story!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, the other day, Ichika and I went over to Ms. Yoisaki's... We went over to the person who I do housework for's house.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Since I was going over with Ichika, I thought that I could make some salmon and cod roe rice balls for them...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But Ichika ended up spending around ten minutes deciding which to eat first.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, ten minutes?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It took me that long...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honestly, how did you end up spending so much time on that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So... I was going to try a cod roe one first since I had had a salmon one just the other day from the convenience store.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: However, I thought the ones Honami made were bound to taste different, which is why my eyes started wandering towards the salmon...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that makes total sense!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I remember buying a ham sandwich from somewhere this one time and having Hona share the ones that she made with me. When I tried them, they were both really yummy♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ohh... That was when your lunch and what you shared ended up being the same thing, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it also happened with egg salad and tuna sandwiches...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you brought a ham sandwich on purpose that time, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! And they were both really good!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I thought the sandwiches you made were better, Hona, because you filled them with so much love!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really? Hehe. Thank you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is why I'd get how you'd want to try something Hona made even though you had something similar from a convenience store just recently.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you for understanding.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see. I think I sorta get why you couldn't immediately decide that time...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But this is a choice between chocolates or gummies. Homemade isn't exactly an option.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! So, why not have both at the same time?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A-At the same time?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Think about orangettes! They give you a yummy mix of orangey and chocolatey goodness, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, why not have both at the same time?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... I guess...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Actually, I'm curious now too.
Let's all try them together♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, let's give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. *Nom*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How is it...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mmm! Really good!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mmmm! It's like this refreshing sweetness that melts in your mouth!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This might actually be the best way to eat these! Shiho, Hona, you both gotta try this!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You think so?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, let's give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mmm. Yeah, this is actually pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it is! I love how your mouth becomes filled with the aroma of chocolates and oranges at the same time. This combination makes my mouth so happy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?! And we have you to thank, Ichi! Your indecision led to this unbelievable discovery!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think you're giving me too much credit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki, Shiho & Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha!
